sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and riding an impressive run of five consecutive wins, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. Alsager arrive in poor form with just one win in their last six matches and sit bottom of the division with only 4 points, making this a strong opportunity for Sandbach to extend their lead at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a crucial away trip to Dawley Town, with Stafford just two points behind Sandbach and capable of closing the gap with a win. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, travel to Eccleshall in a mid-table contest, while fourth-placed Wolverhampton Casuals host struggling Wednesfield Community—both teams showing mixed recent form. Bilston Town (fifth, 17 points) continue their solid run at home against Foley Meir, while Barnton entertain Shawbury United in a fixture between sides in mid-table. Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills in a battle between two teams in the lower half, and Brereton Social host bottom-of-the-table Widnes Town, offering Brereton a chance to climb the table against winless opposition. Cheadle Heath Nomads face away-day pressure at Telford Town in a fixture between the division's two lowest-scoring teams, and Crewe host Allscott Heath as both seek to escape the relegation zone.
